common_prompt: Create one complete beautiful landscape 16:9 concept illustration explaining a proposed software architecture. The central visual message is "different foundations, the same Elsa experience". Elsa's distinctive product assembly contains THREE PEER EXECUTION MODEL OPTIONS (Flowchart, State machine, BPMN) plus Studio for designing and observing workflows. Make this upper assembly the visual hero. It mates to ONE removable foundation chassis through a clearly drawn common contract connector. The installed Elsa foundation contains TWO INTERNAL LAYERS TOGETHER, durable actors above actor runtime. An alternative whole foundation sits alongside, with exactly the SAME connector geometry, representing another actor framework plus its adapter. Replacement is of the ENTIRE lower assembly. Studio belongs visually WITH Elsa above the connector, not down inside the foundation. Show both the built-in foundation and alternative foundation, keeping Elsa intact. Models are peer choices, never three stacked layers. Use precise restrained human-readable labels in a clean typeface. Required labels "Elsa", "Flowchart", "State machine", "BPMN", "Studio", "Elsa foundation", "Framework + adapter". If space allows, label internal Elsa foundation layers "Durable actors" and "Actor runtime", and connector "Execution contract". No unsupported performance claims, brands or logos, invented framework names, paragraphs or tiny filler text. All labels must be readable and have a clear referent. Do not print this instructional prose.

concepts.title: Precision instrument
concepts.prompt: DIRECTION ONE: a premium exploded scientific instrument photographed in a dark olive studio, warm ceramic, burgundy glass, brushed bronze, ivory lettering. The upper hero assembly is a beautiful wide ivory instrument frame containing THREE distinct equal-sized engraved model plates in one row, plus a fourth adjacent Studio panel with a tiny workflow canvas and execution timeline visible on its glass screen. Label each of the first three plates accurately and the fourth "Studio". Small gold "Elsa" lettering on the upper assembly. All four upper panels sit in ONE frame, floating slightly above a substantial bronze standardized mounting rail. Below that rail is a single partly withdrawn graphite foundation cassette. Show its section, with two internal horizontal compartments, upper Durable actors and lower Actor runtime. A second whole foundation cassette stands beside it on the right, visibly ready to fit exactly the same rail. It is cooler slate metal and labeled Framework + adapter. Sparse precise leaders, substantial rich materials in upper Elsa assembly, visually quieter foundation. Photograph at a modest three-quarter angle, elegant wide composition. Upper model plates and Studio must dominate and be equal in clarity. Studio's screen is a product window not an execution model. Absolutely no globe or glowing center mechanism stealing focus from Elsa.

concepts.title: Architectural pavilion
concepts.prompt: DIRECTION TWO: an architectural scale model of a beautiful modular pavilion, brightly lit on a warm off-white studio background. Isometric three-quarter view. A SINGLE floating terracotta-and-cream upper pavilion is labeled Elsa and has three adjoining equal glass-roofed model galleries, each showing its distinct diagram in a physical sculptural layout, and a side-attached Studio gallery with a large glass view of a workflow canvas and timeline. Clean labels on facades Flowchart, State machine, BPMN, Studio. Architecture is elegant Bauhaus, handcrafted wood and matte colored resin. The entire pavilion fits on a standardized perforated foundation mounting plate. Beneath the plate, one modest rectangular plinth labeled Elsa foundation is pulled down in exploded view and shows two shallow internal floors Durable actors and Actor runtime through an open side. To the right sits an alternative complete plinth Framework + adapter with EXACTLY matching mounting points. The contrast between richly articulated Elsa pavilion and sober simple replaceable base should be unmistakable. Both bases are physical alternative supports under ONE upper pavilion, not separate complete Elsa buildings. Beautiful architectural presentation photograph, soft shadows, readable minimal typography, spacious."

concepts.title: Camera system
concepts.prompt: DIRECTION THREE: a refined editorial photograph of an unusual modular medium-format camera system, on deep midnight navy. Elsa is the MAIN hero camera body in sculpted warm ivory ceramic and brushed champagne metal. Built into its rear/side is an elegant Studio screen facing the viewer, displaying a clear tiny workflow canvas plus execution timeline. THREE interchangeable lens-like execution model discs are displayed above the camera body in one neat exploded fan; each has a clear ENGRAVED DIAGRAM on its front and its own legible label Flowchart, State machine, BPMN. All three fit the SAME front bayonet and represent peer choices, do not stack them into one optical path. The camera body and model discs collectively read as Elsa, use a small Elsa wordmark as plain text, no logo. Beneath the body is ONE large standardized quick-release mount, and a separate detachable motor-drive-like lower foundation module labeled Elsa foundation, with a simple two-part cutaway Durable actors above Actor runtime. A second whole foundation module sits to the right labeled Framework + adapter, with visibly identical mating plate. Warm camera body and radiant readable screen dominate, bases in matte dark graphite, rim lighting, restrained mechanical detail, exquisite craftsmanship. No lens brands, real camera brands, people or cables. Have the camera BODY's main title Elsa be legible. Wide format with ample breathing room.

concepts.title: Docking platform
concepts.prompt: DIRECTION FOUR: a beautifully art-directed miniature futuristic docking system, luminous open architecture with the clarity of a product diagram. Pitch-dark teal background and quiet cinematic side light. Top center a SINGLE wide floating pearl-white Elsa module is a horizontal open-sided rack with THREE distinct plug-in execution model cards side by side and an attached Studio observation screen at its right. Cards show branching graph, state rings, BPMN graph. Clear small exact labels Flowchart, State machine, BPMN and Studio. The full module labeled Elsa is visually distinctive with pale coral and warm gold light. Underneath it an exposed standardized mounting connector runs as one clear band labeled Execution contract, precisely repeated on TWO alternative undercarriages below. The installed left undercarriage Elsa foundation shows TWO parts in one shared case Durable actors and Actor runtime. An identical-footprint alternate undercarriage Framework + adapter is on the right, drawn with equal compatible ports, ready to slide into the same slot. A single calm curved exchange arrow between the two lower chassis makes substitution legible. Studio is physically attached to Elsa above, no Studio screen in either lower base. Beautiful restrained futuristic industrial design, no space scenery, no stars, no three-layer station. Prioritize upper Elsa component and make base alternatives quieter."

concepts.title: Theatre stage
concepts.prompt: DIRECTION FIVE: a sophisticated editorial illustration of a miniature theatre as an architecture metaphor, warm ivory paper, forest green, vermilion, pale ochre, crisp cut-paper forms with slight physical depth. Three equal rehearsal scenes share ONE upper proscenium labeled Elsa. The left scene contains a clean branching graph of connected plaques labeled Flowchart, the center contains a circle of three states labeled State machine, the right contains tasks and diamond gateways labeled BPMN. They are abstract diagram sculptures, no actors or people. At the side of the upper stage a Studio control booth has a little workflow canvas and timeline. All four elements are on the SAME UPPER STAGE assembly. The whole stage hovers slightly over one removable rectangular backstage machinery platform below. The platform has ONE standardized connector strip across its top. Its open side shows two machinery drawers labeled Durable actors and Actor runtime, and outside it is labeled Elsa foundation. A second complete alternate backstage platform sits pulled aside to the right, labeled Framework + adapter, with EXACTLY the same connector strip. Make it obvious that the stage can be lowered onto either platform. A clean graphic double-headed arrow between alternative base platforms. One stage, TWO alternative bases, expansive editorial white space, perfect typography, no decorative badges or other copy. Avoid suggesting that Studio is an execution model by giving it a distinct booth shape rather than another rehearsal scene.

concepts.title: Editorial schematic
concepts.prompt: DIRECTION SIX: a precise contemporary 2D editorial architecture poster. Flat clean vector-like design, off-white canvas, oversized indigo upper assembly, vivid coral connector, muted grey-green lower foundations. Slight exploded axonometric only where it clarifies physical interfaces, otherwise absolutely crisp geometry. Upper left small title Elsa, then a beautiful SINGLE substantial indigo frame taking upper half of image contains THREE equal ivory execution-model panels with bold clear diagrams and their exact labels Flowchart, State machine, BPMN. An attached but differently proportioned Studio screen at right shows workflow canvas and timeline, label Studio. Together all FOUR are grouped as ONE Elsa assembly. Below this group, one coral shared interface rail labeled Execution contract. Below it TWO horizontally adjacent alternative foundation modules of equal footprint: left Elsa foundation, open cutaway shows exactly TWO stacked internal sections Durable actors and Actor runtime; right Framework + adapter, closed and neutral with the same matching top connector. Draw a light outline placement guide from the same upper rail to either foundation, or one clean double arrow between the two, to communicate interchangeability. Avoid implying both lower modules run simultaneously as one distributed foundation, clearly depict the right one as a replacement waiting beside the installed module. Elegant use of negative space and type, limited purposeful callouts, no text beyond specified labels, absolutely no glowy blobs, generic chip art or icons unrelated to the architecture.

composition_refinement: Exactly one foundation supports Elsa. The alternative framework and adapter is disconnected to the right, with matching connectors. The execution contract rail connects only to the active Elsa foundation. No people or figurines. The instrument and pavilion were edited to enforce this after their initial generation.
